toml:
# LEO-PNT vertical: railway and maritime, the bundled maritime and rail scenarios plus LEO.
#
# Three phases reuse the engine's own maritime and rail scenarios unchanged and add a low
# Earth orbit (LEO) positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) pass for the same platform:
#
#   strait-jammed  `maritime-strait-jamming` (a ship in the Gulf of Finland, a 17 dBW
#                  broadband L1 jammer about 30 km away): the GNSS carriers fall below
#                  the 25 dB-Hz floor. A `leo-pass` run of the same ship (maritime user,
#                  8 m/s) tracks a generic LEO satellite (1080 km, 97 deg polar orbit)
#                  in its S and C bands, which the L1 jammer does not reach.
#   rail-tunnel    `rail-tunnel-coast` (a train at 44.4 m/s coasting on a tactical inertial
#                  unit in a tunnel, no aiding): the event marks the moment its position
#                  error reaches 2 m, the kind's own crossing time.
#   rail-open      back in the open, a `leo-pass` run of the train (160 km/h east of
#                  Hamburg) tracks a generic LEO satellite (1080 km, 97 deg) in its L
#                  and S bands, the signals a re-acquiring receiver would use to end
#                  the coast.
#
# The alarm follows the jamming kind's own rule (fewer than four GNSS satellites
# tracking) in the strait. The jamming and LEO runs do not share a model: the leo-pass kind
# has no jammer, and the S and C bands are outside the L1 jammer's 20 MHz by construction.
# MODELLED.
kind = "campaign"
title = "Railway and maritime with a LEO layer"
seed = 20260929

[timeline]
step_s = 10.0

[[phases]]
name = "strait-jammed"
duration_s = 1800.0

[[phases.runs]]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "jamming"
seed = 1
mask_deg = 5.0
tracking_threshold_dbhz = 25.0
[phases.runs.scenario.time]
step_s = 30.0
duration_s = 1800.0
[phases.runs.scenario.receiver]
lat_deg = 59.80
lon_deg = 24.90
alt_m = 0.0
[phases.runs.scenario.constellation]
altitude_km = 20200.0
inclination_deg = 55.0
planes = 6
sats_per_plane = 4
phasing_f = 1.0
[phases.runs.scenario.jammer]
position_ecef_m = [2904623.523, 1381438.498, 5489328.347]
power_dbw = 17.0
gain_dbi = 0.0
jammer_type = "broadband"
bandwidth_mhz = 20.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "leo_cn0_s_dbhz", unit = "dB-Hz", t = "satellites[0].series[].t_s", y = "satellites[0].series[].bands[0].cn0_dbhz" },
  { channel = "leo_cn0_c_dbhz", unit = "dB-Hz", t = "satellites[0].series[].t_s", y = "satellites[0].series[].bands[1].cn0_dbhz" },
]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pass"
name = "Ship in the Gulf of Finland"
epoch = "2026-09-28T08:00:00"
duration_s = 900.0
step_s = 10.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
environment = "maritime"
lat_deg = 59.8
lon_deg = 24.9
height_m = 10.0
speed_m_s = 8.0
heading_deg = 45.0
mask_deg = 5.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.satellite]]
id = "LEO-1"
system = "generic-leo"
bands = ["S", "C"]
max_elevation_deg = 75.0
tca_s = 450.0
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 97.0
[phases.runs.scenario.gnss]
enabled = false

[[phases]]
name = "rail-tunnel"
duration_s = 120.0

[[phases.runs]]
events = [{ label = "inertial coast error reaches 2 m", at = "crossings[0].coast_s" }]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "ins-trn-coast"
imu_grade = "tactical"
speed_m_s = 44.4
ref_accel_m_s2 = 0.0
combination = "rss"
crossing_thresholds_m = [2.0, 20.0]
drift_band_lo_m_per_s = 0.001
drift_band_hi_m_per_s = 0.050
trn_fix_mode = "none"
mission_duration_s = 600.0

[[phases]]
name = "rail-open"
duration_s = 600.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "leo_cn0_l_dbhz", unit = "dB-Hz", t = "satellites[0].series[].t_s", y = "satellites[0].series[].bands[0].cn0_dbhz" },
  { channel = "leo_cn0_s_dbhz", unit = "dB-Hz", t = "satellites[0].series[].t_s", y = "satellites[0].series[].bands[1].cn0_dbhz" },
]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pass"
name = "Train east of Hamburg"
epoch = "2026-09-28T08:00:00"
duration_s = 600.0
step_s = 10.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
environment = "ground"
lat_deg = 53.55
lon_deg = 10.3
height_m = 20.0
speed_m_s = 44.4
heading_deg = 90.0
mask_deg = 5.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.satellite]]
id = "LEO-1"
system = "generic-leo"
bands = ["L", "S"]
max_elevation_deg = 70.0
tca_s = 300.0
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 97.0
[phases.runs.scenario.gnss]
enabled = false
